nodes.norm_label: proxy protocol header for kit csrf
nodes.rationale: Without PROTOCOL_HEADER or ORIGIN, Kit's CSRF check rejects form posts and DELETEs over plain http behind the proxy; e2e sends x-forwarded-proto: http, and BODY_SIZE_LIMIT=17M lets 16 MB photo uploads through.
